notes: Upscaling now really runs on your Mac's GPU through Core ML. Since 1.0.1455 a start-up step quietly switched that faster path off, so the speed-ups in the last few versions never reached the app. They do now: on our test Mac a 1-minute 1080p video reached 4K in 5 minutes 7 seconds, down from 10 minutes 21 seconds in 1.0.1466. The picture matches the previous version to within a fraction of a level.
